title: Redirected run correspondence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $b$ be a Boolean value, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $t$ be a nonnegative integer. After $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$, the redirected machine is in the redirected state corresponding to $M$'s state and last output bit at time $t$, with the same input-head position and work tapes as $M$; its output tape is empty.
